sourcePriority: Original drawings and checked design govern dimensions and construction.
Current model governs overall layout, support positions, openings and view composition.
Owner-approved sanctuary and timber-connection concepts govern ornament missing from the model.
Owner confirms an Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary statue between the front towers; its exact niche fit and mounting remain proposed.

resolution.method: Pillow ImageOps.fit, LANCZOS, centered crop to 16:9 then resample to 1920x1080. Sub-pixel edge crop for 1672x941 native output.
resolution.permission: Owner explicitly authorized Full HD copies and retention of native originals.
resolution.limitation: Resampling does not add native detail. Native master is a byte-identical copy of the selected generator output.
